data.name: Jagbir
data.long_meaning: Jag means 'victorious' and bir means 'Lord'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit language and is a tribute to the divine victor. In Hindu mythology, Jagbir refers to the mighty and powerful deity, Lord Krishna, who is known for his victories over evil.
